source.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A via Element84 Earth Search (STAC) and the Sentinel-2 COGs on AWS Open Data
source.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data are free and open (Copernicus data and information policy, EU Regulation 1159/2013).
source.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2017-2026, processed by Kolaboro

method: Per month: b = share of the 150 m circle around the pin that is built-up or bare (Sentinel-2: NDBI above 0 and NDVI below 0.25, so vegetation counts as not built), r = the same share in a ring 300 to 600 m away. Index = (b - r) minus the median of (b - r) over the first 3 clear months, in percentage points. Smoothed = median of the last 3 clear months. "Visible change from" = first month of 3 clear months in a row with the smoothed index at 15 points or more (single-month noise in the first months: median 4, 90th percentile 15). Last 12 months and the 12 before: medians of the smoothed index.
limits: Sentinel-2 pixels are 10 m. They show cleared ground, slabs, roofs and large cranes, not floors, interiors or quality of work: a tower going up on a plot that was already concrete changes little, and a finished building should look unchanged. Season, low winter sun (longer shadows), haze and wet ground also move the index. Cloudy months are empty. The pin comes from public sources and is about 100 m accurate, so the circle can miss part of a large site or include a neighbour. This is a prompt to ask the developer for dated site photos, not proof of progress or of a stop.

notes.flat: marked under construction, construction start on record 12 or more months ago, and the smoothed index moved less than 5 points between the two 12-month windows while staying under 15
notes.rising: the smoothed index of the last 12 months is 15 or more points above the 12 months before
